name: qualizeal
description: QualiZeal's Claude Code plugins for the AI CoE: the AI-DLC Studio and its console.

plugins.name: qz-aidlc
plugins.description: QualiZeal AI-DLC Studio: tested starters for LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Claude Agent SDK, an MCP server, agent memory, text-to-SQL, a command line agents drive tools through, AWS Strands, Microsoft Agent Framework and Go; vectorless and hybrid RAG kits with cited answers, gates and web pages; a board for several agents on one job; lanes to architect, spec with fresh-eyes review, build, evaluate, test, audit, deliver, demo, bid and write office decks and mail; routing that fits the model and effort to the task; a guard that reads every command on a line, per-turn undo, goal mode, a GitHub agent, publishing that saves locally first, an audit chain, run ledger and report cards.

plugins.name: qz-console
plugins.description: QualiZeal console: a live map beside the chat of the AI-DLC harness at work, with the run's lane, stage, token budget and which stations filled the context. Runs in Claude Code (terminal and the desktop Code tab).
